name: Outreach
description: Outreach is a sales engagement platform for building and running multichannel outreach sequences, with real-time conversation intelligence, deal management, and AI-driven forecasting layered on top.
best_for: Sales development and account-executive teams that want to run, track, and optimize multichannel outreach sequences alongside deal and forecast visibility.
features: Multichannel sales sequences with automated activity capture across email, calls, and other channels
Real-time conversation intelligence during calls, including AI-powered battlecards, objection handling, and action-item detection
Deal management with pipeline-bottleneck diagnosis and recommended next steps
AI-powered forecast projection and pipeline insights for revenue prediction
Autonomous AI agents that act on behalf of sellers across the customer lifecycle
Named "Amplify" plan tiers (Essentials, Core, Plus, Pro) that bundle per-seat pricing with an AI-credit allocation

tiers.name: Amplify Essentials
tiers.notes: 10,000 AI credits included. Focused on conversation intelligence and coaching. "Request pricing" only, no public price.

tiers.name: Amplify Core
tiers.notes: 25,000 AI credits included. Focused on pipeline creation and account management. "Request pricing" only, no public price.

tiers.name: Amplify Plus
tiers.notes: 50,000 AI credits included. Marked "Most Popular!" on the pricing page. Focused on revenue acceleration. "Request pricing" only, no public price.

tiers.name: Amplify Pro
tiers.notes: 100,000 AI credits included. Focused on enterprise revenue orchestration. "Request pricing" only, no public price.

pros: Publishes named plan tiers and their AI-credit allocations even though dollar pricing is not public, giving more structure than a flat "contact us" page
States a broad certification set: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and HIPAA-related compliance support, per its trust page
Describes a hybrid seat-plus-usage model explicitly as "per user pricing, no platform fees" for the base seat cost
cons: No numeric self-serve pricing or published free trial; every tier's call-to-action is "Request pricing"
Consumption-based AI credits add a usage dimension on top of per-seat pricing, which can complicate cost forecasting as usage grows
The company's primary domain redirects from outreach.io to outreach.ai, which may confuse users verifying they are on the official site

faq.question: Does Outreach publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. Outreach names four "Amplify" tiers (Essentials, Core, Plus, Pro) differentiated mainly by AI-credit allocation (10,000 to 100,000 credits), but every tier's call-to-action is "Request pricing," with no public dollar amount.

faq.question: Is outreach.ai the same company as Outreach.io?
faq.answer: Yes. Outreach.io now redirects (HTTP 301) to outreach.ai, and the destination site's own structured data identifies it as the same organization.

faq.question: Is Outreach SOC 2 certified?
faq.answer: Outreach's trust page lists SOC 2 Type II among its certifications, alongside ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and HIPAA-related compliance support.

alternatives.name: Salesloft
alternatives.description: A sales engagement platform for running multichannel cadences and managing deals, now combined with Clari's forecasting after their 2025 merger.
alternatives.best_for: Teams comparing Outreach's closest direct competitor in cadence-based sales engagement.

alternatives.name: Apollo.io
alternatives.description: A sales intelligence and engagement platform combining a B2B contact database with sequencing, a dialer, and AI-assisted prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want sequencing bundled with contact-data sourcing and published self-serve pricing.
